```python
nsamples = itmax - itmin + 1
```
Reason:
By adding 1 to the calculation of `nsamples`, the code correctly accounts for the inclusive nature of the time range, ensuring that all samples within the specified range are included, thus fixing the incorrect time information in the synthetic seismograms.
